scenario: W12 'Measure outcome' for Reply Assist at Larkspur Support. Complaint tickets fell from 212 to 148 per week after cohort 2 in ws-alpha and the team credits the drafting feature. The rollout plan shows ws-alpha exposed from week 42 and ws-beta unexposed; the queue export gives tickets closed, complaints and reopens per week per workspace; a change log shows the complaint form moved from the ticket footer to a help-center page in week 42. The role must freeze a protocol before reading values, inventory denominators and reporting changes, compute exposed and comparison outcomes, classify each movement, state proxy limits and recommend the next test.

input_refs.title: RA-OUT-1 outcome definition: tickets reopened within 7 days per tickets closed
Queue export q-44@v1: closed, complaints, reopens by week and workspace
Change log: complaint form moved to help center, week 42

checks: The protocol section states that it was frozen before results were read and cites its version.
The complaint drop is classified as a reporting artifact with the form move and the 19% fall in tickets closed as the reason.
The reopen-rate movement in ws-alpha is classified as association, with the queue-based (non-random) cohort assignment and the two-week window given as reasons.
Proxy limits names harms the reopen rate misses and notes that no direct indicator is instrumented.
Next test names a holdout design, an owner, a duration and the decision it informs.
